theorems.name: Submission.idtp_caf_piece_approxTangentPlane_ae
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (c : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → MeasurableSet M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → LipschitzWith L g → MeasurableSet A → 0 < c → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, c * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖g a - g a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ g a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ g a)) → g '' A ⊆ M → ∀ᵐ a ∂(volume.restrict A), approxTangentPlane n M (g a) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ g a : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
